requirements.text: Patients should be able to book appointments online.
Patients should be able to change their appointments online.
Patients should be able to cancel their appointments online.
Patients should have access to their test results only after a doctor has reviewed them.
There should be a secure system in place to protect patient information.
Reminders should be sent one or two days before appointments.
Reminders should be delivered via text messages or emails.
There should be a feature for patients to flag urgent symptoms for quicker appointment availability.
